race.comment: PIERROPLANE (2) has hit the ground running in his debut prep and finds another good race for him. He has enough early toe to spear across and lead from the wide draw, the added blinkers should have even sharper away. Can lead pillar-to-post. HYSTERICAL LADY (12) will be hoping they overdo it in front so she can launch a late ambush. Relishes this trip and is the one to look out for late in the piece. The 7YO JUSTICA'S BONUS (8) is going as good as ever and gets in well again at the weights with the claim. The form around him is strong and he maps well. Don't underestimate. SILVER LIFESTYLE (6) stuck on strongly to just miss at a juicy quote when resuming at HQ last time. Fitter but will need some luck from out there. POWER DANCER (3) has been mixing his form but goes well over this track and trip. Keeping safe.
